title: DFT relaxation of t-B₂N₃
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization of the provided initial t-B₂N₃ structure using Quantum ESPRESSO with the PBE functional and appropriate pseudopotentials to obtain the relaxed structure and total energy.

title: Save optimized structure as CIF
action: Export the relaxed t-B₂N₃ geometry from the previous step as a CIF file containing the unit cell parameters and fractional coordinates of all B and N atoms.
description: CIF file with the optimized atomic positions and cell parameters. The file must contain at least the unit cell and fractional coordinates of the two distinct B sites and the two distinct N sites.
output_schema: CIF file; the checker will parse it to measure N–N, B–N1, and B–N2 bond lengths.

title: Compute elastic, electronic, and energy properties
action: Using the relaxed structure from step 1, compute elastic constants via finite-strain method, electronic band structure and projected density of states, and total energies of h‑BN and molecular N₂ to calculate the energy density of the decomposition t‑B₂N₃ → h‑BN + N₂. Collect all results in a JSON file.
description: JSON file containing the computed elastic constants, bulk and shear moduli, G₀/B₀ ratio, energy density, and metallicity indicators.
output_schema: Object with keys: c11, c12, c13, c33, c44, c66 (all numeric, GPa), bulk_modulus (GPa), shear_modulus (GPa), g_over_b_ratio (numeric), energy_density_kJ_g (numeric), is_metallic (boolean), band_gap_eV (numeric).
